replacements.Cinco tecnologías en espectro de complej: Five technologies across a spectrum of complexity. Moving to the right = more capability, more cost, more failure surface. The right choice is the simplest technology that solves the problem.
replacements.El problema está bien definido, los caso: The problem is well defined, the cases are enumerable, and the logic does not change. Give a 10% discount to customers with more than two years, block a transaction if it exceeds the limit.
replacements.Más barato, más auditable y más fiable q: Cheaper, more auditable, and more reliable than any model for that kind of problem.
replacements.Las excepciones se multiplican hasta que: Exceptions multiply until nobody can maintain the rule system anymore.
replacements.Hay datos etiquetados disponibles y la s: Labelled data are available and the output is a label or a number. Fraud detection, risk scoring, incident classification, churn prediction.
replacements.Métricas claras, evaluación automatizabl: Clear metrics, automatable evaluation, a reproducible and explainable result. The most robust option for classification and structured prediction.
replacements.No adecuado cuando la entrada es texto l: Not suitable when the input is variable free text, context changes substantially between cases, or content must be generated.
replacements.La tarea es lingüística y el conocimient: The task is linguistic and the model's general knowledge is sufficient: writing, summarization, translation, code generation, concept explanation.
replacements.Un modelo de base sirve para muchas tare: One base model works for many tasks without retraining. Adaptation is cheap through prompting or lightweight fine-tuning.
replacements.Conocimiento estático con fecha de corte: Static knowledge with a cutoff date. It does not access proprietary documents or information from after training.
replacements.El modelo necesita razonar sobre documen: The model needs to reason over current or proprietary documents without retraining. Questions about internal technical documentation, proprietary knowledge bases, changing regulations.
replacements.El modelo puede responder con precisión: The model can answer accurately about information that was not in its training because it reads it on every query.
replacements.Mayor latencia y coste. Si los documento: Higher latency and cost. If the documents are highly specialized or retrieval fails, the answer fails too.
replacements.La tarea requiere múltiples pasos, herra: The task requires multiple steps, external tools, or acting on real systems. Complex automation: search, execute code, call APIs, adjust the plan according to results.
replacements.Capaz de cosas que ningún modelo solo po: Capable of things no model could do alone. Suitable for deep analysis of complex cases or multi-source research.
replacements.Cada paso puede fallar y los fallos en c: Every step can fail and chained failures are difficult to detect. The longer the chain, the less reliable the final result.
